## Body

Review the actual pre-existing authority before grading a grace extension. In #247, live memory add already permitted notes to existing roles in selected registered projects without a holding check. The new post-close exception preserves that verb as the closed author; it does not establish held-role-only authorization. Do not report this as a new privilege escalation without first establishing the intended policy.

Retained LOW C34 follow-up: the grace fallback handles every identity refusal. If native session B reuses closed A's still-live host and pane within the grace, a lingering command asserting A can override the resolver's contradictory-live-owner refusal. With no assertion, B resolves normally. Preserve that cheap contradiction guard; the composed rollover case was source-traced, not executed.

An own-seat memory.note is emitted after commit and consumed through a live, seat-filtered subscription, but it is not prompt-correlated: a note after subscription can finish the wait before prompt delivery. Do not claim strict after-prompt proof. Normal process-start reads are in-process, with the existing counted /bin/ps fallback; no unconditional zero-launch promise.

Evidence: #247 at 9b4edcecb50cec1f12ace63060e9a1d762b7be25; security verdict commit f4f7200. Exact-head Linux CI regressions passed; no local builds/tests. Post-deploy cost and plain-close note-persistence proof were still owed at handoff. Existing notes already cover pending-close ownership and general C33/C34 grading.
